name: Detección de Mejora de Contraste
description: Detecta histograma manipulación artefactos from contraste adjustments like levels, curves, or gamma correction.
algorithm: Peak-Gap Artifact Detection in Pixel Value Histograms
mechanism: Contrast enhancement operations create characteristic peak-gap patrones in the pixel intensity histograma. This method detecta these artefactos mediante el análisis de the regularity and spacing of peaks and valleys.
parameters: Histogram bins: 256, Gap umbral: adaptativo, Peak detección: local maxima, Smoothing: Gaussian σ=1
source: Stamm, M.C. & Liu, K.J.R. (2008) — Forensic Detection of Image Manipulation Using Statistical Intrinsic Fingerprints, IEEE ICME
useCase: Detecting brillo/contraste adjustments used to unify appearance in composited images

references.title: Stamm, M.C. & Liu, K.J.R. (2008) — Forensic Detection of Image Manipulation Using Statistical Intrinsic Fingerprints, IEEE ICME

strengths:
• Detecta multiple enhancement types
• Works on both global and local adjustments
• Fast histograma-based análisis
• Well-established forense technique
limitations:
• Cannot detect very subtle adjustments
• Multiple enhancements may cancel artefactos
• compresión JPEG affects histograma
• Limited to intensity-based manipulacións
